scenes.title: Cloudsway: infrastructure for agents
items: For teams building agents that need real-time information, secure execution and real-world outcomes
Search: real-time, source-backed web data (SmartSearch and Reader, 30+ languages)
ScaleBox: globally distributed sandboxes for agent-written code, files and workflows
Agent API: a managed agent layer built on Search and ScaleBox
scenes.caption: Three products, as described on Cloudsway's own pages.
say: Cloudsway describes itself as AI agent infrastructure.
Three products: Search, ScaleBox and Agent API.

scenes.title: How the Agent API works
scenes.kicker: One task in, one deliverable out
steps: A task is given to the Agent API
Search steps and tool calls stream out
It returns a deliverable: report, table, chart, JSON or file
scenes.caption: Agent API composes Search and ScaleBox, per Cloudsway's pages.
say: The Agent API composes Search and ScaleBox with planning and memory.
Streaming of search steps and tool calls makes a run observable.

scenes.title: What we would do together

before.label: An agent run today
items: A task goes in, a deliverable comes out
Search steps and tool calls stream

The reach is measured against it

scenes.caption: Our suggestion for what we would do together, not a Cloudsway claim.

Agents built on Cloudsway would carry a written mandate and a measured record.

scenes.title: Where things stand
items: The workflow ran live on Cloudsway's platform and worked (our account)
The two sides are exploring an API/billing partnership

scenes.text: Every agent run on Cloudsway should carry a mandate and a measured reach.

say: Reach is what Cloudsway gives agents.
A mandate and a measured reach make that reach something you can account for.
